title: SARL-STG: A Spatially Aware Reinforcement Learning Framework for Refining MLLMs in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: SARL-STG: A Spatially Aware Reinforcement Learning Framework for Refining MLLMs in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) requires models to localize objects both spatially and temporally.

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: Recent attempts using Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) [1, 21, 42] have shown promise in capturing complex associations, yet their reliance on extensive supervised fine-tuning compromises their inherent semantic understanding and open-world generalization [16, 32], delivering inferior accuracy compared to task-specific baselines.

problems.name: Scalability and Corpus-Level Retrieval
problems.evidence_sentence: To facilitate training at scale, we also construct STVG-Wild, a large-scale dataset with diverse spatio-temporal annotations.

methods.name: Object/Event/Spatio-Temporal Modules
methods.evidence_sentence: SARL-STG: A Spatially Aware Reinforcement Learning Framework for Refining MLLMs in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) requires models to localize objects both spatially and temporally.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: To facilitate training at scale, we also construct STVG-Wild, a large-scale dataset with diverse spatio-temporal annotations.

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training
methods.evidence_sentence: To address this core challenge, inspired by recent successes of Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) in enhancing reasoning and grounding [6, 45], we propose SARL-STG, the first RL-based framework specifically designed for STVG.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: To enhance the performance on STVG, we employ a two-stage training strategy: (1) large-scale supervised finetuning (SFT) for all modules to improve spatio-temporal modeling through global-local semantic fusion and temporal interaction modules; (2) targeted RL refinement for the MLLM on high-quality data.
